questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由}X\sim P(\lambda),\ \text{知}D(X)=\lambda,\ E(X)=\lambda,\ E(X^2)=D(X)+E^2(X)=\lambda+\lambda^2.\\&\text{由题设}E[(X-1)(X-2)]=1,\ \text{有}\\&\qquad\qquad E(X^2-3X+2)=E(X^2)-3E(X)+2=\lambda+\lambda^2-3\lambda+2=1\,.\\&\text{即}\lambda^2-2\lambda+1=0,\ \text{故}\lambda=1\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}X \text{表示} n \text{重伯努利试验中“成功”的次数。若设}\\X_i = \begin{cases} 1, & \text{第} i \text{次试验成功} \\ 0, & \text{第} i \text{次试验失败} \end{cases} \quad i=1,2,\cdots,n,\\ \text{则} X = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i \text{是} n \text{次试验中“成功”的次数，且} X_i \text{服从} 0-1 \text{分布。}\\ E(X_i) = P\{X_i = 1\} = p, \quad E(X_i^2) = p,\\ \text{故} D(X_i) = E(X_i^2) - [E(X_i)]^2 = p - p^2 = p(1-p), \ i=1,2,\cdots,n.\\ \text{由于} \, X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n \text{相互独立，于是}\\ E(X) = \sum_{i=1}^n E(X_i) = np, \ D(X) = \sum_{i=1}^n D(X_i) = np(1-p).\end{aligned}
